AI VIDEO CREATORS, HAVE YOU EVER CONSIDERED SELLING SHORT ADVERTISING JINGLES TO BUSINESSES? 😭🔥

Not every advertisement needs a long voiceover.

Sometimes, a short, memorable musical message can make a brand's content more interesting.

And when you combine AI music tools with AI video creation, you can explore an entirely different service.

Let me show you how.

Imagine a restaurant launching a new meal combo.

Instead of creating an ordinary product advertisement, you develop a catchy 15-second musical commercial.

The food is beautifully presented.

There's a fun, original jingle.

The restaurant's name is clearly communicated.

And the video ends with the actual offer and ordering information.

Now imagine doing something similar for:

- Fashion brands
- Restaurants
- Schools
- Retail stores
- E-commerce businesses
- Event organizers

Here's how to start.

STEP 1: Learn how advertising jingles are structured.

A good jingle should communicate a brand's message, not just sound entertaining.

STEP 2: Practice writing short, original advertising lyrics.

STEP 3: Use appropriately licensed music and audio tools to develop your sound.

STEP 4: Combine the music with a well-directed AI video advertisement.

STEP 5: Build three demonstration commercials for fictional brands.

Then research businesses that might be interested in this style of advertising.

You can offer:

A 15-second musical advertisement.

A 30-second brand commercial.

Or a collection of short promotional jingles.

Check the commercial rights for every music and voice-generation tool you use. Don't imitate famous artists or copy recognizable songs without permission.

Here's the opportunity:

YOU CAN COMBINE STORYTELLING, MUSIC, VIDEO PRODUCTION, AND ADVERTISING INTO ONE CREATIVE SERVICE.

The more clearly you define what you're offering, the easier it becomes for a potential client to understand its value.

10 YouTube habits to start in 2027:

1. Package the video before you film it

Write the title and thumbnail first, the idea decides the views.

2. Follow the rule of 15

In the first 15 seconds, name the problem, give the solution, then raise the stakes.

3. Cover one topic

Channels covering 1 topic get a median 65K views, channels covering 8-10 get 12K.

4. Give your opinion

AI answers any question in seconds, so viewers subscribe for your take on it.

5. Write titles in first person

“I tested” and “I lost” went from below average in 2020 to 20% above in 2026

6. Keep editing minimal

We’re in the authenticity cycle, viewers want to see a real person talking to them.

7. Make videos for the TV

YouTube raised the thumbnail upload limit from 2MB to 50MB for 4K TV screens, so check your thumbnail and text read from across a room.

8. Use one end screen

Send viewers to your most relevant video, or the one with the highest retention.

9. Post image polls on your community tab

Channels that post consistently get 20-30% more views, and image polls perform best of every post type.

10. Use AI for research and editing

Then spend the time it saves being on camera.
